title: AI for Data Analysis
description: Use AI to analyze spreadsheets, find patterns, create charts, and extract insights — without writing a single formula.

data.text: One of the most powerful and underused AI capabilities for non-technical professionals is data analysis. Upload a spreadsheet, describe what you want to know, and get instant analysis, charts, and insights — no formulas, no pivot tables, no coding.

data.text: What you can analyze with AI

rows: "Give me a summary: min, max, average, and count by region"
"Show monthly revenue for 12 months and highlight anomalies"
"Group customers by purchase frequency: 1, 2-5, and 6+ times"
"Is there a relationship between lead response time and close rate?"
"Which 10 products have the lowest profit margin? Sort lowest first."
"Find rows with missing values. Show me counts by column."
"Add a column: cost per acquisition = ad spend divided by new customers"
"What are the most common themes in the feedback column?"

cards.title: ChatGPT Plus (Code Interpreter)
cards.description: The most capable data analysis tool for non-coders. Upload CSV or Excel files, ask in plain English, and it writes and executes real Python code behind the scenes to produce tables, charts, and insights.
pros: Executes actual Python — genuine calculation not text generation
Can clean data, merge files, and export results
Shows the code it ran so you can verify the approach
cons: Files reset after session — re-upload each time

cards.title: Claude (Pro tier)
cards.description: Excellent at reading, discussing, and summarizing data in prose. Strong for interpretation, written narratives of findings, and suggesting analysis approaches. Less focused on code execution than ChatGPT.
pros: Superior prose explanations of data findings
Handles reading very large CSV files in context
Strong at suggesting analysis approaches before executing
cons: Code execution less seamless than ChatGPT

cards.title: Gemini Advanced (Google Sheets)
cards.description: If your data lives in Google Sheets, Gemini Advanced integrates natively in a sidebar. Ask questions about your sheet, get formula recommendations, create charts, and get summaries without leaving Sheets.
pros: Native Sheets integration — data stays in place
Can write and insert formulas directly into cells
cons: Requires Google One AI Premium subscription
Less powerful for complex multi-step analysis

data.title: Initial data exploration (start here)
data.content:
"I have uploaded a CSV. The columns represent [describe what each column is]. Please:
1. Tell me the dimensions (row and column count)
2. List column names and data types
3. Flag data quality issues: missing values, outliers, inconsistent formats
4. Give me 3-5 initial observations about the data"

data.title: Specific insight request
data.content:
"Using this sales data, answer these questions:
1. Which 5 salespeople had the highest close rates last quarter?
2. Is there a pattern between deal size and sales cycle length?
3. Which product categories are growing vs declining?

For each answer: (a) a brief written finding, (b) a supporting data table or chart"

data.title: Data transformation and export
data.content:
"Clean this dataset:
1. Remove rows where [column] is empty
2. Standardize [column] to Title Case
3. Convert [column] from MM/DD/YYYY to YYYY-MM-DD
4. Add a calculated column: [describe calculation]

After cleaning, give me the updated file to download."

data.title: Verify numbers before presenting them
data.text: AI-generated analysis can contain calculation errors, especially on aggregations, date math, and percentages. Always spot-check key numbers against your source data before presenting results to stakeholders. For high-stakes decisions, verify analysis in Excel or a BI tool.

rows: AI may miscount, misaggregate, or use wrong formulas
Spot-check 3-5 numbers manually against source data
Mixing up date formats, treating text as numbers
Describe your data schema at the start of the session
Very large files may be truncated silently
Check row counts before and after upload
Save all outputs before closing the chat
AI may claim correlation where there is none
Ask: "How confident are you? What might make this wrong?"

data.title: AI data analysis essentials
points: ChatGPT Plus Code Interpreter: upload CSV or Excel, ask in plain English, get real charts and tables
Gemini Advanced: best if your data lives in Google Sheets — native in-app integration
Start every session with an exploration prompt: dimensions, column types, data quality, first observations
Request output in two parts: written finding plus supporting table or chart
Always spot-check key numbers before presenting — AI calculations can have errors
Verify aggregations, percentages, and date math manually for important decisions
